title: Nasruddin Tale 172: The Hot Bread
summary: Nasruddin pulled a loaf of fresh flatbread from the baking oven and took a massive bite while it was still boiling hot. Burning his tongue and throat, he danced around the room, pa...
full_text:
Nasruddin pulled a loaf of fresh flatbread from the baking oven and took a massive bite while it was still boiling hot. Burning his tongue and throat, he danced around the room, panting and fanning his mouth with both hands.

"Why don't you spit it out?" cried his wife.

"Spit out fresh bread?" gasped Nasruddin. "Never! I would rather let my tongue burn than let honest bread go to waste!"
moral: Impatience burns the tongue; waiting for the right moment brings sweet digestion.
